purpose: Owner-selected four-model pilot; local generation runnable, paid stages require separate route/budget/live-judge validation
reasoning_policy: Non-thinking where supported; verify actual request behavior; score final answer only

judge.policy: One fixed context-bound relevance judge for all arms; errors unscored, not passes
judge.implementation: Shared src/cefr_bench/relevance.py and scripts/judge_saved_answers.py; generation saved first, errors never default to pass

preconditions: Clean and freeze the same human-written item set for all models
Integrate context-bound relevance gate into API and local harness paths
Validate chosen judge with real matched/mismatched preflight calls
Locate and validate local weights; approve any necessary downloads
Check local memory/process headroom and load one local model at a time
Record local runtime, revisions, precision and API provider routes
Approve total paid-call budget including judge calls and retries
Run smoke tests before the full sweep
interpretation: Practical candidate comparison, not a causal size-only experiment: Qwen versions and local/API precision differ
